name: Dishon
title: Descendant of Seir
summary: Dishon (also spelled Dishon/Dishon) was one of the sons of Seir the Horite, who lived in the region of Edom. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the Horite clan leaders in the mountains of Seir. His descendants were among the original inhabitants of the land later taken over by Esau's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: This person is listed as one of the sons of Seir the Horite in the genealogy of Edom's original inhabitants.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Horite Clan Leaders
keyEvents.description: Disjon is mentioned as one of the clan leaders among the Horites in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Disjon's Sons Listed
keyEvents.description: The sons of Disjon—Hesban, Eshban, Jithran, and Keran—are recorded in Genesis as his descendants.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Disjon's lineage is repeated in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place among Seir's sons and the Horite leaders.

keyEvents.title: The Horites' Land Taken Over by Esau's Descendants
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Disjon's tribe, originally lived in the mountains of Seir, but the land was later taken over by Esau's descendants (the Edomites).
